dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, the way those Electro Seelie were chasing... whatever they were chasing around, you'd think they were Electro Cicins!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh. These murals are pretty interesting. Are the mountains painted here ones you can find on Tsurumi Island?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's wondering... Do those stars mark the positions of treasure or something?
